grf.hypothesis: The automatic post-merge integrity receipt advances main without mutating the newly merged ClayCode production bytes.
grf.counter_reality: Receipt persistence races with or rewrites productive ClayCode, invalidating canonical byte binding immediately after merge.
grf.falsifier: Compare the exact merge commit to its immediate successor and require that all changed paths are bounded evidence outputs while the production typechecker blob remains identical.

scope_limits: This does not prove every production file in the repository is immutable under all receipt writers.
This does not mint generic TypeRef semantics.
This does not complete the ClayCode compiler, Clay VM, Linux interop, or ClayOS.
